title: Introduce cross-model calibration SLO adapter and CI gate
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add a Cross-Model Calibration SLO adapter to detect calibration drift across model variants; CI gate blocks merges when cross-model calibration shift exceeds configured thresholds. Includes metrics, docs, tests, and a backfill script.
description:
Motivation: We currently run per-model calibration checks, but when we roll new model variants (quantized, distill, or different checkpoints) we lack a CI-level guard that compares calibration performance across variants. This PR adds a "cross_model_calibration_score" metric and a CI adapter that enforces a configurable SLO for cross-model calibration parity so we can detect regressions caused by model swaps or quantization changes.

What this PR does: 1) Adds an evaluation metric implementation that computes calibration parity across a set of anchored model variants (eval_harness/metrics/cross_model_calibration.py). 2) Adds a CI hook (ci/hooks/cross_model_calibration_hook.py) that can be plugged into the existing eval CI pipeline and will FAIL the gate when the aggregated calibration shift exceeds the threshold. 3) Provides a backfill script (scripts/backfill_cross_model_calibration.py) to compute historical baselines for selected prompt sets. 4) Adds dashboard metadata and a short docs page (docs/metrics/cross_model_calibration.md) explaining interpretation and recommended thresholds. 5) Adds unit and integration tests and an example prompt anchor set.

Checklist:
- [x] Metric implementation with tests
- [x] CI hook and config (default thresholds conservative)
- [x] Backfill script for baseline population
- [x] Docs and example prompt-set anchor
- [x] Load/perf sanity checks on common prompt workloads

Notes/links: Linear: ENG-2321 (calibration SLO adapter); related monitoring work ENG-2390. Implementation intentionally lightweight so it can run as a CI smoke check; heavy historical aggregation is offloaded to the backfill job. The hook emits structured telemetry for Central to consume (metric name: cross_model_calibration_score).

Usage: the gate can be enabled in ci/configs/calibration_gate.yml and supports per-prompt-set thresholds, a global floating threshold, and a human-in-the-loop override via creating a Linear incident (documented in the doc page).

notes_for_release: This PR adds a conservative CI gate for cross-model calibration parity. Default behavior is opt-in in ci/configs/calibration_gate.yml. Operations: start with a low-risk prompt set and run backfill to populate baselines. If you want the gate enabled globally, consult ENG-2321 for threshold tuning guidance.

additional_context: Design note: the adapter computes Brier-based calibration per variant and then reports RMS difference across variants as the cross_model_calibration_score. We intentionally report a single scalar for CI gating and emit per-variant breakdowns for dashboards. We considered a KL approach but opted for Brier parity for interpretability and boundedness. Performance: typical CI runs add ~3s for a 1k-sample prompt-set on a standard runner. Backfill is IO-bound and can be parallelized in the future.
